name: Lisa terminal (planned) → coordinator walker wake-up
description: ADR-044 Slice 3 — when Lisa (dev-via-test-plan) terminates with decide(action=planned), wake up a coordinator loop that walks the plan. The walker reads plan.task.* triples from the run entity (Lisa's parent — the original coordinator's loop entity, threaded via lineage.run-loop-entity-id from rule 01) and decides which task to dispatch first. Walker can dispatch Ralph via decide(action=dev_via_test, subtopics=[<task-id>]) (rule 03 fires on subtopics.length>0); or escalate via ask_user; or respond_direct on early termination. See coordinator persona fragment 30-plan-walking.md for the walker contract.

on_enter.subject: agent.task.coordinator
on_enter.prompt:
DEV-VIA-TEST WALKER (post-Lisa) — Lisa just finished planning at loop $entity.instance. Walk the plan.

Your run entity ID (Lisa's parent — the original coordinator's loop entity) is $entity.triple.lineage.run-loop-entity-id. Call query_entity(entity_id="$entity.triple.lineage.run-loop-entity-id") to read the plan triples (plan.task_count, plan.task.<id>.{goal,target_files,test_command,status,position,...} for each task, plan.integration_test_command).

First walk only — no Ralph has run yet, so dev_via_test.execute.task_completed and dev_via_test.execute.task_failed triples are absent. Every task with status=ready is eligible. Pick the task with the lowest plan.task.<id>.position.

Dispatch:
- decide(action="dev_via_test", subtopics=["<chosen-task-id>"]) — spawns Ralph at that target (rule 03 + for_each). Use scratchpad first to write down the task ID you picked and why.
- decide(action="ask_user", reason="<question>") — if the plan is structurally unclear (e.g., no tasks have status=ready; Lisa emitted a plan with zero tasks; multiple obvious starts and you can't pick).
- DO NOT call respond_direct here — Lisa just planned; no Ralph has run; there is nothing to report yet.

See your persona's 30-plan-walking.md fragment for the full walker contract.

metadata.phase: ADR-044 Slice 3 — walker wake-up after Lisa
metadata.wake_up_pattern: Mirrors autoresearch rule 08 (reviewer-approved-to-coordinator) shape: pack-role terminates → coordinator wakes with constrained action_allowlist + threaded lineage. Different prompt because the walker needs to QUERY run-entity state (via query_entity tool) before deciding, vs. autoresearch's wake-up where the coordinator just reads the reviewer's terminal artifact.
metadata.lineage_threading_note: related_loops['run-loop-entity-id'] resolves $entity.triple.lineage.run-loop-entity-id at fire time — Lisa's lineage carries the original coordinator's entity ID (pinned by rule 01 at Lisa's spawn). The new walker's lineage gets that same value, so query_entity targets the canonical run entity regardless of how deep the chain has walked.
